verdict.rationale: monday.com documents 2-way sync with "any platform", a "real-time, cross-platform view", and 850+ integrations. It also offers adjacent item-level linking such as GitHub/GitLab pull requests and Zendesk tickets, which suggests external work can be centralized in monday boards. However, nothing shows that tasks assigned to you in other project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Trello) can be pulled into a single personal view, so the support is only generic. Missing for 10: named sync with other project management tools, a unified 'my assigned tasks' view across tools, depth of the sync, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
